# Devinno.UI.Wpf {{VERSION}}

> WPF host for Devinno.UI: `ViewControl` is a WPF `UserControl` that shows a `DvApp` inside a WPF window.

1. Devinno.UI.Wpf.xml (`lib/net9.0-windows10.0.19041.0/` in the package; the same folder as this file in `.devinno/Devinno.UI.Wpf/`): C# API reference for `ViewControl` — `App`, update requests (`MarkUpdated`/`MarkRepaint`), text input (a WPF TextBox/PasswordBox over the field, so the OS IME works) or `TouchMode` (built-in virtual keyboard), `ThemeWindow` (title bar and WPF menus take the app theme colors), app closing with the window, and DPI handling. CPU painting only.
2. How to write screens is documented in the core package: read `.devinno/Devinno.UI/llms.txt` (in the Devinno.UI package: `docs/llms.txt`) first.

The app must target `net9.0-windows10.0.19041.0` or later with `<UseWPF>true</UseWPF>`; with plain `net9.0-windows` this package adds no assembly (build error: type or namespace 'Devinno' not found).
